text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm able to get my weight back up before the Japanese Oaks! Unfortunately, I wasn't able to complete Trainer's ideal training regimen…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm worried about how I'll perform, but Trainer tells me to just do my best and not to leave any regrets behind. I'm going to run my heart out today!
